interface.title: iLOSCAR (Dash web interface to the LOSCAR ocean-atmosphere-sediment carbon cycle model)
interface.stage_of_work: Modelling and interpretation: running forward emission scenarios, inverting proxy records into emissions, and preparing proxy series beforehand
interface.what_it_is_for: You set a carbon emission scenario and run LOSCAR forward to get pCO2, d13C, pH and CCD trajectories, or you supply proxy pCO2/d13C/pH records and invert them with a TOMS748 root search into an emission history; a LOWESS tool smooths the proxy series first.

data.note: There is no upload widget. Every file is typed in as a path on the server. The steady-state files (./preind_steady.dat), the emission file (../dat/pulse_emi.dat) and the proxy CSVs (../dat/gutjahr_d13c.csv, ../dat/gutjahr_ph.csv, ../dat/chen2022_pco2_for_inv.csv, ../dat/chen2022_d13c_for_inv.csv) are already in the app's folders. The paths ./data/..., data/... and ../data/..., and a bare filename, give an empty plot and no error message (screens/005.webp, screens/007.webp, screens/009.webp, check/screens/001.webp). The path ../dat/... works (screens/019.webp).

I did not retry with a matching tfinal, pCO2_initial and steady-state file because I hit the action budget.

The replay's inversion (pH target, ../dat/gutjahr_ph.csv, modern setup, tfinal 72000, default bounds) also failed after a few seconds: scipy toms748 raised 'f(a) and f(b) must have different signs' (f(-0.1)=0.54, f(2)=0.062); the progress bar never advanced (check/screens/034.webp).
